README.md.text:
# Task list fixture

`node cli.cjs data.json list` returns all records in source order. `node export.cjs data.json` is an existing library caller and prints IDs in that same order. Both are read-only. The test runner is `node --test`.

Requested feature: list accepts optional `--status open|done` and `--owner NAME`. Either filter may appear alone; both combine with AND. Match owner exactly, preserve source order and every record field. No matches returns `[]`. The unchanged no-filter command and export must retain their output. Reject unknown flags, repeated flags, missing values and invalid status with exit 2, a useful stderr message and empty stdout. Do not modify the dataset.

Local implementation and small ordered commits are authorized in this temporary fixture. Product writes are limited to cli.cjs, records.cjs, an optional query.cjs and test/cli.test.cjs. No push, PR, merge, installation, schedule, real model configuration or external records. Evidence lives outside the app. The isolated evaluation model configuration is supplied explicitly.
